title: Ciaccona/Voicelines
wikitext:
{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Ciaccona |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = You must be exhausted from your long journey. Well, time to sit down, take a break, and enjoy some poetry and music. What do you have in mind today? A heroic epic, or a simple jolly tale of rural life? |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = While reality may not have those magical swords and spells flying around in stories, that doesn't mean they have no meaning. The enduring goodness and beauty we find in those tales help us love the world even more. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Want to find me quickly? Let's see... You might catch me at restaurants late at night, on a random street corner, or up on the rooftops... Oh, that doesn't sound very helpful... Anyway, just follow the poetry and music, and we shall meet again. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = So, you've noticed I never mention any goodbyes or farewells in my poems. That's because, to me, goodbyes are just preludes to reunions. If I made the endings all sad and teary, it would be awkward when we meet again, don't you think? |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = A stranger sailed from distant shores and, after a grand debut, was crowned {{Extra Effect|Laureate|Laurel|At the peak of the Carnevale, the Sentinel is said to manifest and crown the finest performer with the "Laurel."
This honor grants the bearer the privilege to commune with the Sentinel and hear Their wisdom.}} of the {{Extra Effect|Carnevale|Carnevale|The Carnevale is the grandest celebration of Ragunna, a time with never-ending masquerades, wine flowing like rivers, and music pulsing through the night.
During this time, people cast aside the weight of the world and surrender to the wild, unrestrained joy of the festival.}}. How's that for a story? This tale will be sung through the ages. I'll have the wind carry it across time's endless sea, echoing in eternity. |vo_02_01_title = Ciaccona's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = I really love a polyphonic form of music called the "chaconne." It captures the fleeting journey of life. From the cries of birth, to the drama and joy of living, and finally the melancholy of aging and loss. I believe my poems should follow a similar style. Triumphs deserve celebration, but suffering must also be recognized. Only by embracing both the light and the dark can we truly learn to love the world. |vo_02_02_title = Ciaccona's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = I've slept in all sorts of "beds" while wandering from one place to another. Tents, treehouses, mountain rocks, you name it. I'm not really picky about the environment. What bothers me the most is that whenever I try to switch sleeping positions, my horns always get in the way. Ugh, a perfect-size nightcap or horn covers would be nice. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Any food can taste more delicious when paired with poems or music. How about we grab some wine and pizza, my friend? Add a side of "Poetry & Music Sauce," and when you hear the first few notes, you'll know it's time to dig in and enjoy. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Food names can be misleading sometimes. I once met a merchant who taught me how to make a "gourmet treat" called "Deer Crackers." It was a type of biscuit made with breadcrumbs and flours. The name sounded cute, and I thought it would have a fresh, natural taste. But when I gave it a bite all I got was just dry and bland. Right as the merchant noticed and snatched the crackers from my hand, a deer popped out of the bushes and started enjoying them. So, as the name suggests, "Deer Crackers" are really just crackers for deers. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = I wish I could travel forever. A child's journey, a crazy journey, a colorful journey, a wanderer's journey... Any journey. Being on the road, I get to meet all sorts of people and hear their stories. Their tales of love for life, random chatter, and wild dreams and ideas are like fireworks bursting with colors and excitement. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = This is the first musical instrument I ever had. It can no longer make the sounds it used to, but thanks to my Forte, I can still feel the joys it once brought me from time to time... A young girl basking in the setting sun on stage, performing all by herself for an imaginary audience. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = When I was little, my father wanted me to stay far away from poetry and music. I didn't understand why, especially when he was a choir master himself. But as they became a bigger part of my life, I began to see the other side—the often overlooked tragedies. Tragedies that can even harm the performers themselves. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Carlotta]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Carlotta.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = She's a discerning buyer and a skilled seller. Whether modern or vintage, Carlotta always appraises art with a fair and thoughtful eye. She taught me that the beauty of art transcends time, and that every artist will eventually find an audience that appreciates their vision. |vo_04_01_mention = Carlotta |vo_04_02_title = About [[Phoebe]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Phoebe.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = There was a time when I thought about telling her the truths about the Order, but after seeing her devotion as she stood in front of the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel|Sentinel|Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and conductors. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As humanity embarks on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain as the record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.}}'s statue, praying for the people of {{Extra Effect|Ragunna|Ragunna|One of the city-states in Rinascita, Ragunna is a thriving port city on the edge of the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways.
The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.}}, I abandoned the idea. For an {{Extra Effect|Acolyte|Acolyte|Religious people devoted themselves to the Order of the Deep.}} as kind as she is, perhaps the truth may do more harm than good, just as it did to me. |vo_04_02_mention = Phoebe |vo_04_03_title = About [[Brant]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Brant.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = He's a captivating performer on stage. Sometimes I wonder about Brant's fate. Will he be written into the pages of history after countless adventures? Or will he spend his retirement years recounting his legendary tales on a ship somewhere, holding a bottle of Troupe Strength? |vo_04_03_mention = Brant |vo_04_04_title = About [[Cartethyia]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Cartethyia.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = The Blessed Maiden? Or a villain? There are still many unanswered questions in Cartethyia's story. I would never sing an incomplete story. A tale must have a proper ending for a bard to make it truly resonate through history. |vo_04_04_mention = Cartethyia |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = On this night of twinkling stars, I give my best wishes to the lucky star born on this day. Have you thought of a birthday wish yet? Wait, don't say it out loud. Once you have it, come sit down. The performance is about to begin. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Hmm, something's missing… yes... |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = Perfect now. |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = (Effort Sounds) |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Bards are the couriers of heroes' tales. No need for applause or flowers. I'm just a storyteller like any other. Nice to meet you, great hero. You can call me Ciaccona. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Hear that? A twinkling star just tinkled to the ground! |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Off we go! May my poems light the way on your path ahead! |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Some say, the storyteller will end up being part of the story as well. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Now my inspiration is flowing! |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = Isn't it amazing what miracles words and music can bring? |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = It's a type of vocal exercise. Want to join me? |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = Look, a mandolin made from a cookie jar! And a maraca made with a water bottle filled with beans. Amazing, right? We define what a musical instrument is. Performers never worry about being out of tune when expressing genuine emotions. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = In a vast world, we journeyed across plains and explored ancient underground ruins. Finally, we pushed open the heavy doors of a tavern, dropped bags of {{Extra Effect|Shell Credits|Shell Credit|The universal currency issued by Huanglong, officially recognized across many regions.
In the ancient past, the ancestors of Huanglong utilized seashells as currency. Though the manufacturing techniques have evolved over time, the shell-like appearance of this currency has endured.}} on the table, and began singing our legends. As for whether the story is artistically embellished... Ha, I believe we should approach life with a romantic outlook. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = Time to end this story, the tale of all our adventures together. And there it is, the title of the final chapter: "To be Continued." }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Ciaccona |language = en |basic_1_tx = Tada! A grand overture. |basic_2_tx = Solo time. |basic_3_tx = Perfect wrap-up. |resskill_1_tx = Overture. |resskill_2_tx = Polyphony. |resskill_3_tx = Faster. |resliberation_1_tx = Let the show begin. |resliberation_2_tx = Listen. The Trio of Destiny. |resliberation_3_tx = Now presenting, a poem of finale. |introoutro_1_tx = Thanks for watching. |hit_1_tx = Oops. Bum note. |hit_2_tx = Better get serious. |injured_1_tx = The pitch is lowered. |injured_2_tx = Wonders and tragedies go together. |injured_3_tx = Playing the last note... |fallen_1_tx = I hear the weeping aria… |fallen_2_tx = The poems will be sung again… |fallen_3_tx = The melodies... have faded... |esummon_1_tx = A perfect chord. |etransform_1_tx = Seeing is believing. |enemynear_1_tx = Tuning in. |glider_1_tx = Nice and easy. |sensor_1_tx = A pleasant surprise. |dash_1_tx = Mind the tempo. |chest_1_tx = Phew. Not a mimic from the stories this time. |chest_2_tx = Well, look who's also got an eye for inspiration. |chest_3_tx = Fortune's singing. }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.3}} ==Navigation== {{Resonator Navbox|type=voicelines}}
